newsitem.title: ITALY: Italgas H1 1996 falls on extraordinaries.
newsitem.headline: Italgas H1 1996 falls on extraordinaries.

text.p: Italgas, Italy's largest retail gas distributor and part of state energy group ENI, said it posted first half group 1996 pre-tax profit of 219 billion lire against 231 billion in the same 1995 period.
Extraordinary charges for early retirement payments totalled 26 billion, the company said in a statement.
It also said that if its purchase last November of a majority stake in Hungary's Tigaz Rt was taken into account the result would have been 233 billion.
Parent company gross profit rose 3.5 percent to 188 billion lire on turnover of 2.0 trillion lire against 1.87 billion and parent company investments were 252 billion from 192 billion.
Group operating profit was four billion lire up at 258 billion on turnover of 2.59 trillion against 2.43 trillion.
Group financial charges were stable at 29 billion lire.
Financial debt was 655 billion at end-June against 580 billion.
